text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace won the Satsuki Sho. Even 
so, she finds herself unable to rejoice 
wholeheartedly. It was a battle pushed far 
too close to her absolute limits.

Meanwhile, Mr. C.B., who had also suffered 
defeat, cheerfully declared that she was 
looking forward to the Japanese Derby.

What if I can't win next time? Such 
nagging doubts begin to rise within 
Katsuragi Ace.

However, the Trainer believed in her. She 
had grown this strong. So she could win. 
And that's why they would aim for victory 
in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

Spurred by that strong trust, Katsuragi 
Ace fired up. To become the "Ace" of the 
Umamusume world, she charged ahead toward 
the Japanese Derby!
